issue.title: Fleet owner snapshot stays frozen until index gc and a gateway restart
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `fleet owner snapshot refresh (rebuilt only after sase agent index gc and a gateway restart)`

On 2026-09-26, during sase-1aq.4's live Apollo snapshot proof, the owner snapshot stayed frozen for 45+ minutes. It omitted 4 live rows, including 45-minute-old agent sase-1af.5.1, while the summary freshness read aging/partial-false. The snapshot rebuilt only after `sase agent index gc` plus a gateway restart. This landing did not re-run that live case. Later catalog-overlay work serves fresh launches before a rebuild; it does not explain a whole snapshot staying frozen.

Viewers keep a stale fleet until someone restarts the gateway, so live rows disappear from remote and owner catalogs.

task_type_fields.impact: Viewers miss live fleet rows until a manual index gc and gateway restart.
